name: sysopolis
description: Your infrastructure, as a living city. Point it at your stack and explore it as an isometric ops-city.

scripts.demo: concurrently -k -n collector,app -c cyan,magenta "npm run synthetic -w @sysopolis/collector" "npm run dev -w @sysopolis/app -- --open"
scripts.demo:docker: concurrently -k -n collector,app -c cyan,magenta "npm run docker -w @sysopolis/collector" "npm run dev -w @sysopolis/app -- --open"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @sysopolis/app
